title: Do LLMs Adhere to Label Definitions? Examining Their Receptivity to External Label Definitions
reasoning: The paper includes an evaluation component involving the WELLXPLAIN dataset, which features a specific label and definition for 'Spiritual Aspect (SpA)'. It also uses the HATEXPLAIN dataset to analyze how models handle ethically-charged labels such as 'hatespeech' and 'offensive' content.
